answer_1.quote: we propose the Video to Commonsense (V2C) framework to generate visually grounded commonsense descriptions about the underlying event in the video, enriching the factual description provided by a caption...
answer_1.outputs: generated factual captions and commonsense descriptions (intentions, effects, attributes) for each video

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method using BLEU (n=1-4), Meteor, Rouge, and perplexity score of the generation on its corpus...

answer_4.quote: We conduct our human evaluations by crowdsourcing ratings from workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT)... the workers are asked to rate the generated commonsense (intention, effect or attribute) on a scale of 1 to 5... whether the generated text is relevant to the video...
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each generated commonsense description (or caption) on a 1‑5 scale based on its relevance/plausibility to the video and caption.
